question: Estimate the average e-commerce orders placed per urban Indian household per month.
idealClarificationQuestions: Active urban household (placed at least 1 order in past 90 days)? Yes.
Includes Amazon + Flipkart + Myntra + Meesho + Nykaa + AJIO etc.? Yes.
Excludes food delivery, quick commerce, OTA, edtech? Yes — physical goods only.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Top-down: total physical-goods e-commerce orders India / active urban shopping households.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total annual e-commerce orders in India (physical goods): ~5.5B (Amazon ~1.3B, Flipkart ~1.5B, Meesho ~1.5B, others ~1.2B).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Monthly: ~4.5-5 orders per active urban household.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total annual e-commerce orders in India (physical goods)

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Monthly: ~4.5-5 orders per active urban household.
